'''Ead Vinor''' was a major shareholder in [[Bunkurd Corporation]]. He was assassinated by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Kylaena]], something that caused her to become one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild's]] top ten most wanted criminals.
